newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Implats sees Russia holding platinum stocks.
newsitem.headline: Implats sees Russia holding platinum stocks.

text.p: South African platinum producer Impala Platinum Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it saw continued Russian sales of the metal in the medium term.
Implats senior manager marketing Derek Engelbrecht said at the company's half-year presentation that Russia was estimated to have supplied 1.1 million ounces of platinum to the market last year.
Even though market speculation held that Russia would run out of stocks in future, Implats believed that the Russians would not de-stock completely, Engelbrecht said.
"The Russians will continue to feed the market, they still have a good need for dollars," Engelbrecht said.
"The stocks are finite and we believe that they will not de-stock completely and lose their leverage on the market," Engelbrecht added.
He said Russian supply to the market in the medium term could be in the region of a million ounces, dropping back to estimated current production levels of around 600,000 to 700,000 ounces a year.
